name: Moving With Children
description: Produces child-specific task layers for household moves including age-appropriate conversation guides, school transition checklists, emotional preparation strategies, and child-focused moving day plans. Supplements the general moving-checklist with tasks specific to relocating with children of different developmental stages. Use when the user asks about moving with kids, helping children adjust to a move, or child-specific moving logistics. Do NOT use for general moving logistics without children (use moving-checklist), international relocation, or child custody and relocation legal issues (consult an attorney).
